name: firm-negotiation-plan
description: Prepares a negotiation plan with your real alternative and your walk-away point, the client's alternatives marked known or assumed, what you can trade and what you ask in return, what you will not give, the concession order and the question you ask before any discount, with every number set by you. Use for "run firm-negotiation-plan", "the client wants a discount", "should I lower my fee", "prepare me for the fee negotiation", "what is my walk-away point", "they asked me to sharpen my price", "what can I trade besides money", part of the Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude Pack by 90n.
